However, there are certain career backgrounds that fit nicely into the fabric of Utility Warehouse - especially if that background specialises in the nurturing and development of others. A perfect example of this are teachers. They often excel with UW for a number of reasons, not least because of their ability to set goals and to motivate. In this video, we meet three Partners who have all stood at the head of a classroom - and who still do. We hear what made their journeys smoother as a result of their professional background, and what lessons you can learn from their experience. The message is clear: with the right attitude and application, anyone can succeed with UW! Share this video Link copied
